# InspectAPedia

> > A comprehensive building diagnosis and repair encyclopedia providing visual identification guides, historical dating methods, and inspection techniques for residential and historic structures.

InspectAPedia is an authoritative resource for building inspectors, homeowners, and restoration professionals seeking to identify building components, determine construction age, and understand building systems. The site combines photo guides, technical specifications, and historical context to help diagnose building problems and date structures through their materials and components.

## Key Topics

- Building Age Dating
- Home Inspection
- Historic Buildings
- Building Components
- HVAC Systems
- Electrical Systems
- Plumbing Systems
- Door Hardware
- Plaster & Drywall
- Wood Framing
- Antique Materials
- Construction History
- Building Materials
- Component Identification
- Maintenance & Repair

## Building Age & Dating Guides

- [How old is my building?](https://inspectapedia.com/Design/Age_of_Building.php): Guide to determining building age via components and materials
- [Historic houses: How to Identify & Inspect Historic Homes & Old Houses](https://inspectapedia.com/home_inspection/Historic-Home-Inspection.php): Guide to identifying and inspecting historic and old homes
- [Architecture: Building Types & Component Identification Guide Home Page & Article Index](https://inspectapedia.com/Design/Building_Architecture.php): Photo guide to architectural styles and building component identification
- [Kit Home Identification Key](https://inspectapedia.com/Design/Kit_Houses.php): Kit home manufacturer identification and building history guide

## HVAC & Mechanical Systems

- [Age & Life of Heating Boilers & Furnaces](https://inspectapedia.com/heat/Age_Of_Heaters.php): Guide to reading HVAC equipment data tags for age determination
- [Air Conditioners: Air Conditioner Data: Air Conditioning & Heat Pump Data Tags De-Coded](https://inspectapedia.com/aircond/Data-Tag-Decoder-Air-Conditioner-Heat-Pump.php): HVAC data tag decoder for AC units and heat pumps specifications

## Electrical Systems & Components

- [Building Electrical Component Age](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Electrical-Component-Age.php): Determine age of electrical panels, wiring, and components
- [Old Electrical Wiring History & Types](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Old_Electrical_Wiring.php): Photo guide to old electrical wiring types in historic buildings
- [Antique Electrical Receptacles - Outlets Identify old electrical receptacles (wall plugs or outlets)](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Antique-Old-Electrical-Receptacles.php): Antique electrical outlet identification and age history guide
- [Antique & Old Light Bulbs Photo Guide & Catalogs of Antique Lamps (Bulbs)](https://inspectapedia.com/electric/Antique-Light-Bulbs-Lamps-ID-History.php): Photo guide and catalogs for antique light bulb identification

## Interior Materials & Finishes

- [Interior Wall Coverings A Guide to Building Age & Choices of Wall Sheathing or Coverings Indoors](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Interior_Wall_Covering_Choices.php): Identify plaster, drywall, and fiberboard types as building age guide
- [Plaster Types & Methods in Buildings](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Plaster_Systems_in_Buildings.php): Identify, install, and repair plaster and interior wall systems
- [Flooring, Age & components](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Age_of_Flooring.php): Flooring material history and age determination guide
- [Door Age: Door Locks, Knobs, Hinges Hardware as Indicators of Building Age](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Door_Age.php): Using door hardware to determine building age and construction history
- [Nail & Spike Age, History, Uses](https://inspectapedia.com/interiors/Nails_Hardware_Age.php): Antique nail history and chronology for building age determination

## Structural & Framing Systems

- [Wood framing tables, damage & repair: Wood frame construction specifications: spacing of framing members](https://inspectapedia.com/structure/Framing_Size_Spacing.php): Wood framing specifications, spacing tables, and building age clues
- [Antique Log Home Repair](https://inspectapedia.com/structure/Antique_Log_Home_Guide.php): Inspection and repair guide for antique log homes and structures
- [Porch Column Repair Life](https://inspectapedia.com/exterior/Wood_Column_Repairs.php): Wood porch column inspection, repair, and replacement guide

## Plumbing & Water Systems

- [Plumbing age, water heater age, plumbing fixture age: How to Determine the Age of a House and its Plumbing System](https://inspectapedia.com/plumbing/Age_of_Plumbing.php): Determine house and plumbing system age via fixtures and components
